fails_if: the row hash stops tagging each value with its storage class (say it hashes the value's text), so 1, '1', X'31' and 1.0 collide and their tables read as identical; or the report drops its note on `int_real`, whose integer 1 and real 1.0 SQLite groups as one value, leaving a difference with no differing rows unexplained; or `--json` prints a sample cell other than in its storage class (integer and real as JSON numbers, text as a string, a BLOB as a `{"blob": …}` object, NULL as null), so integer 1 and text '1' print alike
note: The note text is the report's explanation for a fingerprint difference with an empty row diff, read from dbdiff's module (the replaced test asserted only that a note is present). Each sample cell is the fixture's value in its storage class; a BLOB prints as its length and the hex of its bytes.
